_about: The carried children (tools/carry_pose.mjs bakes them, tools/carry_check.mjs checks them). Per prop: carrier, child (the rigged character worn), height_m (the child's standing height), tris (decimation budget), recipe and its numbers p, sites (carrier surface sites: the point nearest to joint + off, off in the carrier's body frame x left / y up / z forward, or in the axes of joint `axes`; snapped onto the triangles of `bones`), contacts (site = a carrier site, child = the child's bones whose surface must touch it; tol_bind / tol_cycle the gap limits, m). The clip and bind time are the carrier's characters/props.json entry.

contacts.name: child L hand on his L shoulder
child R hand on his R shoulder
child L thigh at his L flank
child R thigh at his R flank
his L palm under the child
his R palm under the child
child chest on his upper back
